info.main_intro: I am an intelligent personal productivity bot designed for automated daily briefs, task management, and omni-channel utility.
info.section_finance:
💰 *FINANCE TOOLS*
- `/balance` : Check account balance
- `/record <amount> <desc>` : Record expense
- `/income <amount> <desc>` : Record income
- `/history` : View transaction ledger
- `/chart` : Financial visualization chart
- `/finance_info` : Comprehensive finance guide
info.section_system:
⚙️ *SYSTEM & DEVOPS*
- `/ping` : Bot health & resource stats
- `/info` / `/start` : Show this guide
- `/lang [en|id]` : Toggle bot language (English / Indonesian)
info.section_ai:
🧠 *AI AGENT HARNESS*
Send any normal message without '/' to chat or trigger tasks naturally!
- `/model_info` : Available AI models
- `/switch` : Switch active AI brain model
- `/summarize` : Morning brief & chat summarizer
info.section_utilities:
🛠️ *UTILITIES*
- `/weather <city>` : Weather forecast
- `/prayer <city>` : Islamic prayer schedule
- `/remind add <time> <msg>` : Schedule reminders
- `/short <url>` : URL shortener
- `/research_info` : Reference finder (books/journals)
- `/downloader` : Social media media/audio download
- `/me` : About bot creator
info.section_converter:
🖼️ *CONVERTER & MEDIA* 📄
- `/img_info` : Image conversion & removal guide
- `/pdf_info` : PDF tools & merge guide
- `/sticker_info` : Sticker generator guide

google.help_body:
If you encounter any issues or have questions about bot features, use our CS options:

1. `/feedback [message]` : Submit suggestions, criticism, or bug reports to the Fuenzer team.
2. `/ask [message]` : Ask Admin anything regarding bot operations.

Examples:
`/feedback Translation error when translating to Korean`
`/ask How do I upgrade my premium quota?`
google.feedback_prompt:
Please write your feedback message after the command.
Example: `/feedback This bot is awesome!`
google.feedback_success: ✅ Thank you! Your feedback has been sent to the Fuenzer Studio team.
google.ask_prompt:
Please write your question after the command.
Example: `/ask When is the next release?`
google.ask_success: ✅ Your question has been forwarded to Admin. Please wait for a reply!

admin.menu_body:
📋 *ADMIN FEATURES* 🛡️
- `/admin` : Show admin command menu
- `/monitor` : Check website health
- `/cmd_usage` : Bot usage statistics
- `/ai_usage` : AI token usage statistics
- `/broadcast` : Broadcast message to all users
- `/answer [id] [message]` : Reply to user inquiries
admin.menu_footer: Use the commands above to access administrative features.
admin.broadcast_prompt:
Enter broadcast message!
Example: /broadcast Scheduled maintenance tonight at 23:00
admin.answer_prompt:
Format: /answer <id> <reply_message>
Example: /answer 123 Here is the response
